test_check_environment: test the check_environment function to validate Linux platform and required tools like useradd and sudo
create_sanitize_username: create a sanitized Linux username from an arbitrary user ID string using alphanumeric filtering and hash fallback
build_ensure_os_user: build an OS user account with home directory, proper permissions, and group memberships for multi-user isolation
run_resolve_user: run resolve_user to map an upstream user ID to a provisioned OS user with in-memory caching
review_sanitize_username: review the sanitize_username function to ensure it handles short IDs, digit-starting names, and prefix configuration
